title: Beyond Size: How Gradients Shape Pruning Decisions in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2311.04902v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) with billions of parameters are prime targets for network pruning, which removes some model weights without hurting performance. Prior approaches such as magnitude pruning, SparseGPT, and Wanda either concentrated solely on weights or integrated weights with activations for sparsity. However, they overlooked the informative gradients derived from pretrained LLMs. In this paper, we present a novel sparsity-centric pruning method for pretrained LLMs, termed Gradient-based Language Model Pruner (GBLM-Pruner). GBLM-Pruner leverages the first-order term of the Taylor expansion, operating in a training-free manner by harnessing properly normalized gradients from a few calibration samples to determine the pruning metric, and substantially outperforms competitive counterparts like SparseGPT and Wanda in multiple benchmarks. translated_abstract: arXiv:2311.04902v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：拥有数十亿参数的大型语言模型（LLMs）是网络剪枝的主要目标，剪枝旨在在不损害性能的前提下移除部分模型权重。先前的方法如幅度剪枝、SparseGPT和Wanda要么仅关注权重，要么将权重与激活值相结合以实现稀疏性。然而，这些方法忽略了从预训练LLMs中获取的蕴含丰富信息的梯度。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的以稀疏性为中心的预训练LLMs剪枝方法，称为基于梯度的语言模型剪枝器（GBLM-Pruner）。GBLM-Pruner利用泰勒展开的一阶项，以无需训练的方式运行，通过利用少量校准样本的适当归一化梯度来确定剪枝度量，并在多个基准测试中大幅超越SparseGPT和Wanda等竞争方法。有趣的是，通过引入梯度，我们方法的非结构化剪枝倾向于重新……
tldr: 提出GBLM-Pruner，一种利用泰勒展开一阶项、基于少量校准样本归一化梯度的免训练剪枝方法，在大语言模型剪枝中显著优于SparseGPT和Wanda等现有方法。
en_tdlr: GBLM-Pruner, a training-free pruning method that leverages the first-order term of the Taylor expansion with properly normalized gradients from a few calibration samples, substantially outperforms SparseGPT and Wanda for pruning large language models.
